THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IN FAVOR OF PLAINTIFF SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY OF THE CITY AND COUNTY OF SAN FRANCISCO AND AGAINST DEFENDANT CHRIS CRONANDER. 1. THAT PLAINTIFF BE AWARDED A TOTAL OF $4,188.10, THIS AMOUNT REPRESENTING THE TOTAL OF RENTAL ARREAS, LATE FEES, RCOVERABLE ATTORNEY FEES AND RECOVERABLE COSTS UP TO AND INCLUDING MAY 30, 2013. 2. THE PLAINTIFF BE AWARDED IMMEDIATE POSSESSION OF SLIP D029 AT THE SOUTH BEACH HARBOR. 3. THAT PLAINTIFF BE AWARDED IMMEDIATE POSSESSION OF THE JOYCE ANNE (CF#7285ET, HIN#2435L) AND BE PERMITTED TO CARRY OUT THE SALE OF THE JOYCE ANNE IN SATISFACTION OF PLAINTIFF'S LIEN UNDER CALIFORNIA HARBOR AND NAVIGATIONS CODE SECTION 500 ET SEQ. AND ALL APPLICABLE DEPARTMENT OF MMOTOR VEHICLE PROCEDURES. THAT PROCEEDS OF SUCH SALE OF THE JOYCE ANNE BE APPLIED TOWARD SATISFACTION OF THIS JUDGMENT. 4. THAT, SHOULD THIS JUDGMENT BE SATISFIED IN FULL, ALL REMAINING PROCEEDS OF THE SALE OF THE JOYCE ANNE BE DISTRIBUTED TO DEFENDANTS CHRIS CRONANDER.
